title: Bench test procedures: static strength (T-S1 to T-S5)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/testing/test-plan.md lists tests in one line each. A lab cannot run them yet. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write lab-ready procedures for T-S1–T-S5: purpose, specimen and sample size, apparatus, conditioning, fixtures, load rates, measurements, pass criteria tied to REQ IDs, and report template.
acceptanceCriteria: Every T-S test covered; each references its REQ IDs
Public standards cited by number and title only
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
